knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
savannah_climate <- read.csv("ghana_outbreak_climate.csv")
```

```{r}
savannah_climate <- savannah_climate %>%
  rename(T = avg_t)
```


```{r}
#TSI
# Based on Gaythorpe et al. / Mordecai et al. parameters for Aedes aegypti
calculate_tsi <- function(temp) {

# Biting rate (a) 
  
a_c    <- 0.000272  # Scaling constant
a_Tmin <- 13.35     # Thermal minimum 
a_Tmax <- 40.13     # Thermal maximum

# Biting rate (a) calculation
a <- a_c * temp * (temp - a_Tmin) * sqrt(pmax(0, a_Tmax - temp)) #Brière thermal response

# Use the variables for the cutoff to ensure consistency
a <- ifelse(temp > a_Tmin & temp < a_Tmax, a, 0)
  


# Mortality (mu) - 1/lifespan

mu_c    <- 0.148 #Mordecai 2017
mu_Tmin <- 9.16
mu_Tmax <- 37.73

lf <- mu_c * (temp - mu_Tmin) * (mu_Tmax - temp) #quadratic thermal response
mu <- 1 / pmax(lf, 1) #provide floor, avoid dividing by zero


#PDR or Incubation rate (1/EIP)
c_eip <- 0.0001
tmin_eip <- 17.67
tmax_eip <- 42.1

# Calculate the Rate (PDR) or sigma_v
sigma_v = c_eip * temp * (temp - tmin_eip) * sqrt(pmax(0, tmax_eip - temp)) #Brière thermal response
sigma_v = ifelse(temp <= tmin_eip | temp >= tmax_eip, 0, sigma_v)


# Total TSI
tsi_val <- ifelse(sigma_v > 0 & a > 0, (a^2 * exp(-mu / sigma_v)) / mu, 0)
  
 # Return all components for graphing
  return(data.frame(
    a = a,
    mu = mu,
    sigma_v = sigma_v,
    TSI = pmax(tsi_val, 0)
  ))
}

```


```{r}
# Use rowwise to apply the function to each temperature value 'T'
savannah_TSI <- savannah_climate %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  reframe(date = date, T = T, calculate_tsi(T))

# View the first few rows to confirm columns (a, mu, TSI) are added
head(savannah_TSI)
    ```
    
    
```{r}
library(scales)
library(lubridate)
```




```{r}
savannah_TSI %>%
  # 1. Convert the character column to a real Date object
  mutate(date = ymd(date)) %>% 
  select(date, a, mu, sigma_v) %>%
  pivot_longer(-date, names_to = "Component", values_to = "Value") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = Value, color = Component)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~Component, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "1 month",
    date_labels = "%b %d, %Y"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  ) +
  labs(title = "Biological Drivers of TSI", x = "Date")
```

```{r}
savannah_TSI_plot <- savannah_TSI %>%
  # 1. Convert date to actual Date class to ensure lines connect correctly
  mutate(date = ymd(date)) %>% 
  select(date, a, mu, sigma_v) %>%
  pivot_longer(-date, names_to = "Component", values_to = "Value") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = Value, color = Component)) +
  # 2. Add the line first
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) + 
  # 3. Add the points on top
  geom_point(size = 2) + 
  facet_wrap(~Component, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%b %Y") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none" # Optional: hide legend since facets are labeled
  ) +
  labs(title = "Biological Drivers of TSI", x = "Date", y = "Value")
```

```{r}
plot(savannah_TSI_plot)
```

```{r}
#Save the plot as a TIFF
ggsave(
  filename = "savannah_TSI_components.tiff",
  plot = savannah_TSI_plot,
  width = 8,       # Width in inches
  height = 10,     # Height in inches (tall because of 3 facets)
  dpi = 300,       
  bg = "white"
)
```



```{r}
#Graph the TSI (Transmission Suitability)
savannah_TSI_plot2 <-savannah_TSI %>%
  mutate(date = ymd(date)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = TSI)) +  
  geom_line(color = "firebrick", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Yellow Fever Transmission Suitability (TSI)",
       subtitle = "Savannah Climate: Calculated from Aedes aegypti parameters",
       y = "Index Value", x = "Date") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
plot(savannah_TSI_plot2)
```

```{r}
#Save the plot as a TIFF
ggsave(
  filename = "savannah_TSI.tiff",
  plot = savannah_TSI_plot2,
  width = 8,       # Width in inches
  height = 6,     # Height in inches
  dpi = 300,       
  bg = "white"
)
```

save(savannah_TSI, file = "savannah_TSI.RData")
